_about: Verifier's own reading of the record's video (Angrylanks 9:48.183, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgtFCclM1jM), taken 2026-10-12 in the built-in browser: new tab, paused and muted, quality hd720 (player stats: 1280x720@60, avc1.4D4020 itag 298), seek to (n + 0.5)/60 s, wait for 'seeked', drawImage to a 1280x720 canvas, analyse in the page. Nothing was downloaded; the tab was closed afterwards. Video frame n covers [n/60, (n+1)/60) s. Numbers below are copied from the page-script results.

0.00 / 1.00 at all three (scan step 1/600 s); a 59.94 stream would show phases about 0.49, 0.48 and 0.48 there
frame_rate.content_cadence: mean abs difference of successive frames 1500..1539 alternates about 11 / 0.3: a new picture about every 2 video frames (30 pictures a second), occasionally 1 or 3. Each picture is two console frames woven by lines (a new sprite first shows on every other line group at reduced brightness).

game_area_px: x about 298..1265, y 0..720 (left strip is hand camera and splits)

start.metric: max over rows 50..99 of the mean blue channel in columns 360..387 (first medal) / max over rows 56..109 of the brightest channel in columns 470..529 (where Bill first appears)
start.reading: 719: no medal. 720-721 (one picture): medals on one field only (3-row comb, about half brightness), no Bill. 722-724: medals on both fields, Bill on one field. Our emulator shows medals on console frames M and M+1 and Bill from M+2, so picture 720/721 = console (M-1, M) and picture 722.. = (M+1, M+2).

end.metric_a: count of trouser-blue (B) and skin (S) pixels and their bounding box in x 700..1009, y 440..589

series_a.35980-36010: about 245B 400S, box top y = 547 (prone, facing right)

end.metric_b: max over rows 499..539 of the brightest channel in columns 860..899 (where the standing torso and head are, empty while prone)
end.reading: Prone (Down held) and facing right through 36010. 36011-36012 (one picture): prone figure and standing figure each on one field. 36013 on: standing, facing right, gun forward.
end.looked_at: character-art dumps of x 806..1000, y 493..595 for 36010, 36011, 36012, 36013 in the page (not saved as pictures)
end.heart_explosion: explosion-coloured pixel count in the heart area steps up at 35779 and again 35788-35798; not pinned to a frame by me. Stand minus that = about 213-232 video frames; our run: 35066 - 34842 = 224.

span.tolerance: +/-2 video frames on the span from the 2-frame pictures (+/-1 at each event; both events are of the same kind, new state on one field first), +/-3 allowing for the irregular cadence: +/-0.05 s
